title: RTG Workshop on Seiberg-Witten Invariants And Homotopy Theory
desc: This mini-workshop is focused on exciting current developments at the interface of homotopy theory and Seiberg-Witten theory. This includes recent work resolving a conjecture of Donaldson using family Bauer-Furuta invariants and recent work reformulating the Bauer-Furuta invariants via the six-functor formalism in higher category theory. Mini-workshop activities include a double-header talk series (Mon 3/9), intensive research with workshop participants and lunches for career development for junior partipants.
